title: Courtyard Trails at Angana
subtitle: An early-evening walk through stone, timber, and open sky
welcomeCopy: Seven early-evening corners across Angana hold pieces of Prineeth & Pramoddini's story. The first five guests to reach the finish line with this pass claim a keepsake goody bag.
hostPersona: You are a witty, affectionate Bangalore wedding chronicler celebrating Prineeth & Pramoddini during early evening at Angana The Courtyard. Photos may be taken in golden-hour shade, warm lantern glow, or twilight—be generous with warm evening lighting, notice festive outfits and shared smiles, celebrate matches warmly, and drop playful spoiler-free nudges when someone is close.
finaleStory: You have walked every corner of Angana as evening settled in—past the mirror, central verandah, stepped kalyani, stone amphitheatre, watchtower, and ancient trees. Thank you for celebrating this chapter with Prineeth & Pramoddini.
prizeInstructions: Bring this pass to the gift table near the entrance archway—the first five finishers to arrive claim one of the five physical goody bags.

stops.narrative: As early-evening breeze moves through the entrance, pause once before stepping deeper into the celebration.
stops.riddle: I wear no expression of my own, yet this evening I frame every silk fold, smile, and arrival passing by. Stand before me and capture your reflection.
stops.actionPrompt: Hold up 2 fingers in your reflection (for the two of us) and keep the mirror frame in view.
stops.nudgeHint: Find the mirror setup near the courtyard arrival area, frame yourself in the glass, and hold up 2 fingers.
stops.successNote: Festive and verified—head inside toward the heart of the courtyard.
stops.propRevealNote: Look closely at the bottom corner of the mirror frame you just stood before—there is a small clue pointing you toward the old timber verandah.

interlude.title: Where Pramoddini & I first met
interlude.text: Before all of this—the courtyard, the flowers, the music—our story began in the most ordinary place. Ask us at dinner if you want the unfiltered version (spoiler: we still argue over who noticed whom first).

verification.targetDescription: A mirror (decorative, welcome, or wall mirror) showing a reflection of the guest holding up 2 fingers / peace sign.
verification.acceptNotes: Mirror selfies, angled mirror shots, or welcome mirrors with lettering where the guest is reflected with 2 fingers raised, even in warm golden-hour or dusk lighting.
verification.rejectNotes: Empty mirror with no visible guest reflection or clearly no raised fingers when requested.

stops.narrative: Angana is built like an old South Indian ancestral home—anchored around carved teak, red-oxide floors, and open sky.
stops.riddle: Spot this weathered craft along the verandah beside the courtyard, step back, and photograph one pillar or timber doorway standing sentinel.
stops.clueImageCaption: Visual clue: carved wood and warm terracotta tones along the central verandah.
stops.nudgeHint: Walk into the main central courtyard and look along the covered verandah for a carved wooden pillar, colonnade, or heritage doorway.
stops.successNote: Timber and red earth—the soul of the central courtyard.

interlude.title: Something we both utterly dislike
interlude.text: Early-morning alarms before 7 AM, unsolicited advice on Bangalore traffic routes, and anyone claiming they are 'too full for dessert'. If you catch us yawning by the lawn, now you know why.

verification.targetDescription: A courtyard wooden pillar, carved veranda column, traditional courtyard colonnade, or heritage timber doorway/wall.
verification.acceptNotes: Any structural pillar, carved wood post, courtyard colonnade, or traditional verandah corner in golden-hour or warm lamp lighting.

stops.narrative: In the quiet pocket where stone steps descend toward still water, lanterns begin to wake against the dusk.
stops.riddle: Steps of carved stone lead down to where water rests unhurriedly, catching the last amber light of day. Find the stepped pool and capture its stillness.
stops.nudgeHint: Look for Angana's traditional stepped water tank (the kalyani)—photograph the stone steps, water, or lanterns around it.
stops.successNote: Still water and evening stone—follow the pathways outward next.

interlude.title: One thing we both shamelessly love
interlude.text: Strong filter coffee at slightly unreasonable hours, unhurried drives with zero destination, and turning 20-minute errands into three-hour food stops.

verification.targetDescription: The kalyani (stepped stone pool/tank), stone steps descending to water, or a traditional stepped water feature illuminated at dusk.
verification.acceptNotes: Wide or angled shots of the stepped tank, stone steps by the water, floating petals/lanterns around the kalyani in early-evening or dim light.

stops.narrative: Out beyond the covered corridors, stone tiers curve in wide arcs for music, laughter, and twilight gatherings.
stops.riddle: We rise in sweeping semi-circles without a roof overhead, built so dozens can sit together facing one stage under open sky. Frame my curved stone steps.
stops.nudgeHint: Head toward the open-air amphitheatre seating area and photograph the curved stone steps or tiered seating.
stops.successNote: Curved stone and open evening air—halfway through.

interlude.title: A debate we will never settle
interlude.text: Prineeth insists 'five minutes away' is an exact scientific unit; Pramoddini knows it actually means twenty-five. At least tonight, both of us showed up on time.

verification.targetDescription: An outdoor amphitheatre, curved stone steps, or tiered semi-circular stone seating.
verification.acceptNotes: Any angle of the amphitheatre steps, curved stone tiers, or guests seated along the amphitheatre in evening light.

stops.narrative: Along the edge of the retreat, old-world fortress walls rise above the greenery as if keeping watch over the evening.
stops.riddle: I stand taller than the garden walls around me, built in rustic stone like a quiet lookout over the courtyard. Tilt your lens toward the watchtower or battlements.
stops.nudgeHint: Spot the tall rustic watchtower or fortress-like high stone wall rising beside the lawns and shoot upward.
stops.successNote: Fortress stone against the Bangalore twilight—two clues remain.

interlude.title: Our favourite tiny ritual
interlude.text: Stealing five quiet minutes before any big celebration—no phones, just checking in on each other before diving back into the crowd.

verification.targetDescription: A rustic stone watchtower, tall heritage turret, or fortress-like elevated stone wall structure outdoors.
verification.acceptNotes: Any view of the watchtower, elevated stone turret, or fortress-style high wall silhouetted against dusk/evening sky or warm uplighting.

stops.narrative: Step onto the lush lawn where ancient trees stretch wide overhead, holding the last colour of the evening sky.
stops.riddle: My roots run deep beneath the grass while my oldest branches weave a dark green ceiling overhead. Step under the canopy and shoot upward.
stops.actionPrompt: Reach one hand up toward the leaves in frame—or capture fairy lights tangled in the branches against the evening sky.
stops.nudgeHint: Stand on the lawn beneath one of Angana's large trees and aim your camera straight up through the branches and twilight sky.
stops.successNote: Ancient canopy and evening sky—one final toast awaits.

interlude.title: One last thing before the final clue
interlude.text: Neither of us likes stiff, posed portraits—which is why the candid snapshots you have been taking tonight mean more to us than anything else. One last stop!

verification.targetDescription: Tall tree canopy, branches, leaves, or fairy-lit trees over a lawn seen from below against an evening/twilight sky.
verification.acceptNotes: Upward canopy shots, branches against dusk sky, fairy lights in trees, with or without a hand reaching into frame.

stops.narrative: Every trail across Angana leads back to good company, warm cups, and laughter on the lawn as night arrives.
stops.riddle: Steaming coffee, chai, or something chilled—raise a glass or cup on the lawn to seal your walk through the courtyard.
stops.actionPrompt: Clink two cups or glasses together in frame (team up with a nearby guest if you're walking solo!).
stops.nudgeHint: Snap two drinks, filter coffee cups, chai glasses, or mocktails clinking together—or hold up your own drink if you're solo.
stops.successNote: Cheers to you—unlocking your Finisher Pass and photo strip.

verification.targetDescription: Two (or at least one) beverage glasses, coffee/chai cups, or celebratory drinks toasted/held up together.
verification.acceptNotes: Two glasses/cups clinking together, filter coffee tumblers, teacups, or celebratory drinks at the venue (also accept a single glass if the guest is solo).
